column1: # Yamanote Line station sequence with published operating distance (営業キロ).
# Order is the outer loop (外回り
# the origin of JR East's official kilometrage for this line.
# dist_from_prev_km for Shinagawa is the loop-closing segment from Takanawa Gateway.
# cumulative_km is measured from Shinagawa = 0.0 and is PUBLISHED
# from coordinates. Sum of dist_from_prev_km = 34.5 km
# jy_number is JR East's published station numbering. Note it runs the
# OPPOSITE way round from this file's order: JY01 is Tokyo and the
# numbers increase in the inner-loop direction
# and the sequence here counts down. Source: en.wikipedia Yamanote Line.
